description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing improved performance, security patches, and access to modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build tool configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all source and target compiler settings are updated to Java 25. Validate that any removed or deprecated APIs used in the codebase are replaced with supported alternatives. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded java.version in pom.xml from 21 to 25. Spring Boot 4.0.1 is compatible with Java 25. Build and all unit tests pass. No source code changes were needed.
